194:t_1:172.en:
$n
「Sorry... Once I use 《$$ブーストアップ$$》, I can't summon $$ジェニオン$$ for an hour.」

194:t_1:173.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Why would you use something so important...!?」

194:t_1:174.en:
$$ノノ$$
「He used it to save you, Big Sis! What else could it be!?」

194:t_1:176.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We mustn't let $n's hard work and guts go to waste!」

194:t_1:178.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! I'm with you, Big Sis!」

194:t_1:180.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ギルター$$! We'll be your opponents!」

194:t_1:181.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Most of your soldiers are at the concert, though. Your security must be pretty thin!」

194:t_1:182.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh... Heh heh... That foolish assumption has shortened your lives.」

194:t_1:185.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I needn't rely on that rabble of ordinary soldiers. I have $$バイオロイド$$s and $$インセクト$$s under my command.」

194:t_1:186.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Now, my faithful soldiers! Trample the ants that have crept into my base to your hearts'...」

194:t_1:189.en:
$$宗介$$
「Did you think we'd wait for the order to start fighting, you third-rate hack...!?」

194:t_1:190.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$バイオロイド$$ unit, advance! Kill them!」

194:t_1:192.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Impossible! A $$バイオロイド$$ taken down with a handgun...!」

194:t_1:194.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn it! All units, charge! Don't let them escape!」

194:t_1:195.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Who made the foolish assumption, $$ギルター$$!?」

194:t_1:196.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Everyone, attack! Now we're going to raise hell!」

194:t_1:203.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Ha ha ha ha! It's fun when I don't have to hold back!」

194:t_1:204.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「Considering who we're fighting, you needn't! Go all out, $$ハレルヤ$$!」

194:t_1:205.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「You don't have to tell me!」

194:t_1:206.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Hell yeah! Against machines, I can use my hole-digging power!」

194:t_1:208.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Heh, heh, heh... Heh, heh, heh...」

194:t_1:209.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$甲児$$! The two of us will finish this today!」

194:t_1:210.en:
$$甲児$$
「You got it, $$竜馬$$! Let's make it dynamic!」

194:t_1:215.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Wh-what is this!? A dream... a nightmare!?」

194:t_1:216.en:
$n
「Keep saying that and you'll never wake up, $$ギルター$$!」

194:t_1:217.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Keep charging! We'll free the prisoners!」

194:t_1:219.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-wait! You can't go any farther...!」

194:t_1:220.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't think you've got a future.」

194:t_1:221.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's enjoy the present to the fullest, $$ギルター$$!」

194:t_1:226.en: ～$$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$ Concert Venue～

194:t_1:227.en:
$$クラン$$
(They just aren't getting into it...)

194:t_1:228.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
(I knew our fake $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ act would have its limits, but we're reaching them faster than I expected.)

194:t_1:229.en:
$$カナリア$$
(It seems word that the infiltration team was discovered has reached the soldiers.)

194:t_1:230.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(This is bad... The troops here might get orders to deploy too.)

194:t_1:231.en:
$$アルト$$
(Their morale is low. If we get them more absorbed in the concert, we should keep them here a little longer even if orders come...!)

194:t_1:232.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Hey... Is this all the famous $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ can do?」

194:t_1:233.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「That's weird... When I heard their songs on the western $$オセアニア$$ front, they really... hit me right in the heart...」

194:t_1:234.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(The crowd's getting restless. Are we reaching our limit...?)

194:t_1:235.en:
$$カナリア$$
(Tell $$ルカ$$ we'll pull out when the time is right.)

194:t_1:236.en:
$$アルト$$
(Damn it...! We haven't even found $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ yet...)

194:t_1:241.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$ルカ$$...! Stop the recording!」

194:t_1:242.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go!! Listen to my song!!」

194:t_1:243.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「There are two $$熱気バサラ$$s...!」

194:t_1:244.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Th-that aura...! The one who just arrived must be the real deal!」

194:t_1:245.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Then the guys who were onstage before were impostors!?」

194:t_1:247.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Yeah! I can't get enough of this beat running through my body!」

194:t_1:250.en:
$$クラン$$
「The atmosphere changed in an instant...!」

194:t_1:251.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You guys know how to rock! Now let's keep it coming!」

194:t_1:252.en:
$$アルト$$
「All right...! We'll leave this to $$バサラ$$ and pull out.」

194:t_1:253.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Quit sneaking around, $$アルト$$! Let me hear the shout from your soul!」

194:t_1:254.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Send your song out to those two!!」
